bootstrap_policy: Preserve complete frozen 13115 actor MLP including output; fresh critic, Adam, std and V6 counter zero. No source acceptance inherited.
early_stop: Only three consecutive stage-2 full validations plus independent 128-episode confirmation can publish. Plateau cannot mark success.

reward_revisions.0: Base native lift objective plus initial declared upper-body pose, chest angular rate and controlled-return tracking rewards.
reward_revisions.1: Base lift revision 1; upper chest_weight=2.5, chest_rate_weight=1.0 and return_velocity_weight=1.25; native PD, residual caps and acceptance gates unchanged.
reward_revisions.2: Base lift revision 2; upper chest_weight=3.0, chest_rate_weight=1.0, arm_weight=1.75 and return_velocity_weight=1.25; native PD, residual caps and acceptance gates unchanged.

symmetry.scope: Weak mirror consistency on feasible samples; native asymmetry retained.
